comparison.objective: Feed a hex shaft through two aligned bearings with usable projection at both ends.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-part pose alignment, close-clearance insertion, and incremental regrasping through two apertures.
comparison.success_condition: Shaft crosses both bearings, projects at least 1 cm beyond each outside face, and becomes still.
comparison.reason: This is a dual-aperture insertion task. The candidate's brief hex-bit insertion is only a generic primitive within a substantially different adjust-lock-test procedure.
